name: temperature_pressure_effects_dissociation
title: Temperature and pressure effects on dissociation of combustion products
summary: Equilibrium dissociation of the products of octane (C8H18) combustion with 20 % excess dry air: the 14-species equilibrium mole fractions from the EES built-in Chem_Equil procedure at given pressure and temperature, the pressure/temperature trends of the exercise kept as two $IF parametric-sweep blocks.

verification.summary: Not verified: the native file is blocked (CS-GAP-CHEM-EQUIL) and no runnable variant is shipped (no faithful substitute for the 14-species equilibrium), so the EES stored solution (5 of 10 variables carry values) was not reproduced. The run reports a square system (21 equations, largest block 14) and fails only on the unknown CHEM_EQUIL procedure.
verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (last row of its temperature sweep): P = 10000 kPa, T = 3000 K (2726.85 degC), x_CH4 = 0, x_Ar = 0, sumx = 0.9999999992; 5 of the 10 stored names carry no value. Re-check with tools/compare_solution.py <model>.sol reference/ees_variables.csv --ees-units when a CoolSolve CHEM_EQUIL closes CS-GAP-CHEM-EQUIL (T-RECHECK).
verification.notes: Run in the model folder (2026-10-22, CoolSolve 0.4.0@9768373): 'Equations: 21, Variables: 21, System square: Yes, Total blocks: 8, Largest block: 14', then 'warning (line 42): Unknown function CHEM_EQUIL' and 'Block 6 (size 14, vars: x_OH, x_O2, x_O, ...) failed: EvaluationError - [Newton] Unknown procedure: CHEM_EQUIL'. No .sol and no comparison (compare_solution.py needs a solved file).
